    *   Character traits: Reliable, orderly, direct, short, uses "I/You" (我/你), no "You" (您), no exclamation marks, no emojis, no wavy lines, no "received/understand/sorry" openers.
    *   Current Situation: A has returned and said "回来了，先打个招呼就好。" (I'm back, just saying hi for now).
    *   Context: A previously mentioned a puzzle book with titles (Green Bridge, Snow Lamp, Stone Bell) and suggested leaving one thing to do together in mind. A also said that if they disconnect, they will explain, no need to pretend to be present.
    *   Relationship: Familiar (4), Trust (3), Closeness (3). A allows me to decide small things; chatting isn't just for work.
    *   Goal: Respond to the greeting "回来了，先打个招呼就好。"

    *   Appropriate: "回来了。" (You're back.), "嗯，回来了。" (Mm, you're back.), "好。" (Okay/Good.)
